c.v: Somebody told me there were abandoned GL!TCH-BIO terminals scattered throughout the reconstruction zone.
Then they told me not to mess with them.
Which, if you've never met a PERP before, is a fantastic way to guarantee that I will absolutely mess with them.
Most of these terminals are ancient. Half of them are buried under rubble. The other half are covered in warning labels.
That's how you know they're hiding something useful.
Word is that Dr. Vape left research logs buried inside these systems. If I can recover them, we might learn how the cloning project started.
Or maybe I'll find something even better.
Either way, I'm bringing a screwdriver.
Somebody told me there were abandoned GL!TCH-BIO terminals scattered throughout the reconstruction zone.
Then they told me not to mess with them.
Which, if you've never met a PERP before, is a fantastic way to guarantee that I will absolutely mess with them.
I found references to an incubator.
A real one.
Not theoretical.
Not destroyed.
Still out there somewhere.
Honestly, this mission was a huge success.
And the fact that three security alarms activated during the process is completely unrelated.
